entities.summary: Emily Elizabeth "Lillie" Edwards Holman, better known by her professional name of E. E. Holman, was an American architect. Active from the 1880s to her retirement in 1914, she was responsible for planning several important historical sites like the Goold House in the Wilder Village Historic District, Wilder, Vermont and the National Park Seminary among many others.
